Since point $C$ lies on line $AB$, its coordinates must satisfy the equation of the line. Let the coordinates of point $C$ be $(x, y)$. Then, we have $y = -\sqrt{3}x + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$.

This means that the distance from $C$ to the origin $O$ is the minimum distance among all points on $\overline{AB}$.
